routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's labels (and title/content/color/reminder); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
archive or unarchive a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin or unpin a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
permanently delete a note from the Trash view; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
empty the trash; returns 200 with the removed count

notes: REQ-2.7.2 reuses the REQ-2.7.1 label infrastructure end to end. The seed DB gains the fixture note 'Team retro remove label' (id seed-label-remove-272, content 'Agenda for team retro') with labels ['Work'] so the home page already shows a note that has the 'Work' label (the label chip 'Work' is visible on the card). The 'Change labels' dialog (More options -> 'Change labels') renders each catalog label ('Work', 'Reminders', 'Work editable') as a native checkbox; the 'Work' checkbox starts checked for this note. Unchecking it (REQ-2.7.2) removes the label from the note via the existing optimistic update + PATCH /api/notes/:id {labels: []} (backend already persists the labels array), so the label chip disappears from the card and selecting 'Work' in the sidebar label filter no longer shows the note in the filtered list. No new routes or UI elements are needed; the fixture data is the only addition.
